title: Greek
summary: GREEK, adjective Pertaining to Greece. [See Gray.] GREEK, noun A native of Greece. 1. The language of Greece. GREEK-FIRE, a combustible composition, the constituents of which are supposed to be asphal

inlines.v: GREEK, adjective Pertaining to Greece. [See Gray.] GREEK, noun A native of Greece. 1. The language of Greece. GREEK-FIRE, a combustible composition, the constituents of which are supposed to be asphalt, with niter and sulphur.
